No laptops are failing a high-severity compliance check on their latest snapshot. The only high-severity check is `disk_encryption`, and it currently passes on all 10 devices.

**Evidence**
- I filtered for laptops failing at least one high-severity check, and nothing matched. All the failing checks in your organisation right now are medium severity (14 failures).
- `disk_encryption` is the only check rated high severity, and it is failing on 0 devices. It was also failing on 0 devices on both the first day (2026-05-14) and the last day (2026-06-12) of the 30-day window.
- Two medium-severity checks are failing. You didn't ask about these, but they're the active issues:
  - `screen_lock` is failing on 5 devices, up from 0 at the start of the window. That's a new and growing problem [1LYSSFD074BB/2026-06-12, 8NM23J95R5I6/2026-06-12, DLT35MHGTH2D/2026-06-12, DSYPSES7SKBB/2026-06-12, MT7PJB7N5LRE/2026-06-12].
  - `os_up_to_date` is failing on 9 devices, the same number as at the start of the window [1LYSSFD074BB/2026-06-12, 7VP16KHV88LM/2026-06-12, 8NM23J95R5I6/2026-06-12, 9MXJVZ1I0DKA/2026-06-12, DSYPSES7SKBB/2026-06-12, M4XVHUV1MEPZ/2026-06-12, MT7PJB7N5LRE/2026-06-12, Q3VUITEGQ400/2026-06-12, XSU9UUDGU6AC/2026-06-12].

**Caveats**
- The severity levels come from the compliance data, not your organisation's policy. The policy sets no severity levels for compliance checks; it only rates risky software (for example, uTorrent is rated high), and that's separate from compliance checks.
- This only looks at each device's latest snapshot. I didn't check whether any laptops failed high-severity checks earlier in the window.
- I didn't sort the medium-severity failures into laptops and desktops. I can do that if you'd like.
